business_problem: replace fragmented HR systems and manual hiring workflows that made it hard to predict onboarding risk, reduce dropouts, and scale AI-driven recruiting efficiently.
solution_summary: LTM uses Snowflake, Snowpark, and Cortex AI on Snowflake to replace fragmented hr systems and manual hiring workflows that made it hard to predict onboarding risk, reduce dropouts, and scale ai-driven recruiting efficiently. LTM consolidates hiring, onboarding, and enterprise HR data that previously lived in siloed systems and manual processes onto Snowflake. Snowpark runs the core analytics and model logic for joiner prediction, while Cortex AI helps the team build AI-driven recruiting experiences without maintaining brittle monolithic code. HR and recruiting teams use the unified platform to predict post-offer dropouts earlier, tailor engagement, and ship new AI/ML hiring applications faster. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI.
